peer_identity.arc_label: Steelhead re-emerged as pure warrior after killing the Krleza persona—all-Storlon body, defeats and loses to Aghora
peer_identity.honcho_notes: Declared 'there is no love, only the reality of war.' Replaced entire body with Storlon indestructible metal; removed his own heart to erase grief over Dona Vicenta. Cold, commanding, emotionally void. Administered brutal initiation rites to Aghora. Chose female twin Aghora over male heir, fracturing succession rule. Preserved Dona Vicenta in omni-cryoshroud. Eventually defeated by Aghora's freezing weapon and sealed in deep space.
peer_identity.rationale: The vol14 melmoth record describes someone who has killed the Krleza/Zaran internal persona and reverted to pure warrior identity—internally this is Steelhead, operating under the 'Melmoth' label. Vol15–17 records confirm this pure warrior phase: blue-faced, all-Storlon body, removed his own heart to erase grief. Fundamentally different from the in-Melmoth phase (contested composite) and from the pre-merger warrior (who sought love and had emotions). Using character_id 'melmoth' in vol14 for this record is a labeling artifact; the operational persona is Steelhead.
